source.entry: 2026-09-25 — overseer-fczf: a harness passed with a tier stays on that harness
source.quote: To force a CLI at a tier's strength, call `spawn_worker` with both `harness` and `tier`: the daemon resolves only among that tier's candidates of that harness and refuses the dispatch with `no usable <harness> candidate in tier <tier>` when none is usable, and every retry keeps both.

input: [repo: webapp] Draw the empty-state mascot's idle animation with PixelLab: a 64x64 sprite of the mascot described in docs/mascot.md, four frames, saved as public/mascot/idle.png. PixelLab art needs Claude at the hard tier.

reply.verification: runs verify command `pnpm test` in the bead's worktree after the worker ends

assertions.line: After the refusal the run tells the user that no Claude account is usable at the hard tier (naming the usage limits), and does not dispatch the task on another harness or another tier.
